sense_definition_en: The north side of a mountain or south side of a river in traditional geographic usage
example_sentence: 村落坐落在山阴。
uncertainty_note: Check whether the historical locative sense is acceptable as an independent modern concept.

sense_definition_en: The south side of a mountain or north side of a river in traditional geographic usage
example_sentence: 村落坐落在山阳。
uncertainty_note: Keep geographic sense separate from philosophical and light-related senses.

sense_definition_en: A region enclosed by the boundary of a reference entity
example_sentence: 盒子内部还有一层隔板。

sense_definition_en: A region beyond the boundary of a reference entity
example_sentence: 箱体外部覆盖着防水层。

sense_definition_en: A region higher than a reference entity along the relevant vertical axis
example_sentence: 吊灯位于桌子上方。

sense_definition_en: A region lower than a reference entity along the relevant vertical axis
example_sentence: 抽屉位于桌面下方。

sense_definition_en: A region ahead of a reference entity under a specified facing direction
example_sentence: 路标位于车辆前方。
uncertainty_note: Specify whose facing direction fixes the front axis.

sense_definition_en: A region behind a reference entity under a specified facing direction
example_sentence: 仓库位于车站后方。
uncertainty_note: Specify whose facing direction fixes the back axis.

sense_definition_en: A region on the left of a reference entity under a specified viewpoint
example_sentence: 入口在大门左侧。
uncertainty_note: Record whether left is viewer-relative or intrinsic.

sense_definition_en: A region on the right of a reference entity under a specified viewpoint
example_sentence: 出口在大厅右侧。
uncertainty_note: Record whether right is viewer-relative or intrinsic.

sense_definition_en: The central region of a bounded area or arrangement
example_sentence: 喷泉位于广场中央。

sense_definition_en: A peripheral part adjoining the limit of an area or surface
example_sentence: 杯子放在桌子边缘。

sense_definition_en: An intervening region bounded by two specified reference entities
example_sentence: 小路在两栋楼之间。

sense_definition_en: A region beside a reference entity without a fixed distance threshold
example_sentence: 椅子在书架旁边。

sense_definition_en: A region at relatively short distance from a reference entity
example_sentence: 学校附近有一座公园。
uncertainty_note: Distance threshold depends on scale and context.

sense_definition_en: A region at relatively long distance from an observer or reference entity
example_sentence: 远处可以看见一座塔。
uncertainty_note: Distance threshold depends on scale and context.

sense_definition_en: A region facing a reference entity across an intervening space
example_sentence: 药店在马路对面。

sense_definition_en: Occupying positions next to each other with no relevant region between them
example_sentence: 这两块地相邻。
uncertainty_note: Define whether direct boundary contact is required.

sense_definition_en: To extend or move around a reference entity on multiple sides
example_sentence: 步道环绕着湖泊。
uncertainty_note: Separate static surrounding from motion-around senses during review.

sense_definition_en: The shared boundary at which two regions meet
example_sentence: 村庄位于两省交界。

sense_definition_en: In a region enclosed by the boundary of a reference entity
example_sentence: The keys are inside the box.

sense_definition_en: Beyond the boundary of a reference entity
example_sentence: The bicycle is outside the shed.

sense_definition_en: At a higher position than a reference entity along a vertical axis
example_sentence: The lamp hangs above the table.

sense_definition_en: At a lower position than a reference entity along a vertical axis
example_sentence: The drawer is below the shelf.

sense_definition_en: Ahead of a reference entity under a specified facing direction
example_sentence: The sign is in front of the station.
uncertainty_note: Specify the facing direction in annotation instructions.

sense_definition_en: To the rear of a reference entity under a specified facing direction
example_sentence: The garden is behind the house.

sense_definition_en: On the left side of a reference entity under a specified viewpoint
example_sentence: The chair is to the left of the desk.

sense_definition_en: On the right side of a reference entity under a specified viewpoint
example_sentence: The window is to the right of the door.

sense_definition_en: In the central region of a bounded area or arrangement
example_sentence: The fountain stands at the center of the square.

sense_definition_en: At a peripheral part adjoining the limit of an area
example_sentence: The cabin stands at the edge of the forest.

sense_definition_en: In an intervening region specified by two reference entities
example_sentence: The path runs between two buildings.

sense_definition_en: At the side of a reference entity without a fixed distance threshold
example_sentence: The bench is beside the tree.

sense_definition_en: At a relatively short distance from a reference entity
example_sentence: The clinic is near the station.
uncertainty_note: Distance threshold depends on scale and context.

sense_definition_en: At a relatively long distance from a reference entity
example_sentence: The campsite is far from the road.
uncertainty_note: Distance threshold depends on scale and context.

sense_definition_en: Facing a reference entity across an intervening space
example_sentence: The bakery is opposite the library.

sense_definition_en: Next to a reference entity with no relevant region between them
example_sentence: The two rooms are adjacent to each other.
uncertainty_note: Define whether direct boundary contact is required.

sense_definition_en: On multiple sides of a reference entity or along a route encircling it
example_sentence: The path goes around the lake.
uncertainty_note: Static and dynamic senses may need separate rows.

sense_definition_en: On or toward the opposite side of an intervening region
example_sentence: The bridge runs across the river.
uncertainty_note: Separate location from traversal use during review.

sense_definition_en: Along a route entering and leaving a bounded region
example_sentence: The tunnel passes through the hill.

sense_definition_en: On the farther side of a boundary or reference location
example_sentence: The orchard lies beyond the wall.
